game.title: Deathloop
game.blurb: First-person action game about breaking a time loop on Blackreef, from Arkane Studios, released 2021-09-14. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Breaking the Loop
chapters.summary: The story of Blackreef, told as hidden milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Visionaries and Perfect Loops
chapters.summary: Killing every Visionary, surviving all four time periods, AEON dossiers and challenge runs with limits.

chapters.title: Invasions: Colt and Julianna
chapters.summary: Fighting off an invading Julianna as Colt, and hunting Colt as Julianna.

chapters.title: Slabs and Powers
chapters.summary: Infusing and upgrading Slabs, and feats with Havoc, Shift, Nexus, Karnesis, Aether and Masquerade.

chapters.title: Weapons, Trinkets and Residuum
chapters.summary: Infusing weapons, carrying Trinkets, loadout value and absorbing Residuum.

chapters.title: Blackreef Secrets and Stunts
chapters.summary: Hidden targets, prototypes, Charlie's games, gas, candy, falls, the machete and other tricks.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Deathloop" or "DEATHLOOP". deathloop.fandom.com answers the API under "Deathloop", with only 14 linked articles, including "Blackreef", "Colt Vahn", "Julianna Blake", "Trinkets" and "Weapons"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1252330 is "DEATHLOOP". 19 of 58 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the story chapter, though some with low unlock rates (2 to 9%) may be side secrets. "Masquerade" is Julianna's, so "Dressing Down" sits with invasions. The achievement data does not say whether Julianna invasions are online, so the chapter does not claim it.
